params: {"page": n, "x0": pt, "y0": pt, "x1": pt, "y1": pt, "story"?: StoryRef} (a pen stroke in page points, 0-based page: a rectangle at least 12 pt each way outside any table inserts a one-cell table of that size at the paragraph under its start; a straight vertical or horizontal line inside a table splits the cells it crosses there. In the app the button turns the pen on.)

label: Eraser
params: {"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt} (removes the border between two cells within 4 pt of the point: cells that make one rectangle merge, including cells merged down the same rows; otherwise the border is hidden along the whole edge. In the app the button turns the eraser on.)

label: Resize Table by Dragging
params: {"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt, "toX": pt, "toY": pt, "shift"?: bool, "ctrl"?: bool, "reach"?: pt} (a mouse drag in page points, 0-based page, starting on a table border or the resize handle: a column border moves (the column to its right gives or takes the difference, so the table keeps its width; with ctrl the columns right of it share it in proportion; with shift, or on the table's right edge, only the column left of it changes); the table's left edge moves a left-aligned table's indent, the first column making up the difference (a centred or right-aligned table keeps its alignment: only the first column changes); with cells of the table selected, a border of theirs moves only in their rows; a row's bottom border sets that row's height; the handle just outside the bottom-right corner scales every column and the rows on that page. `reach` (default 3) is how near the start has to be.)

label: Select Table Cells by Clicking
params: {"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt, "toX"?: pt, "toY"?: pt, "reach"?: pt, "extend"?: bool, "anchorRow"?: n} (a click in page points, 0-based page, on a selection area of a table in the caret's story: just above a column selects the column, left of a row the row, along a cell's left edge inside it the cell, the move handle past the top-left corner the table; with toX/toY (a drag) every column, row or cell from there to that point; the page margin beside a table (its leading side: right for a right-to-left table) is a row area too, and `extend` (Shift+click) on one takes the rows from the selected ones' anchor, or from row `anchorRow` (0-based) when given, so a drag keeps its press's anchor. `reach` (default 3) is the column borders' resize reach, which the cell areas keep clear of.)

label: Insert Row or Column by Clicking
params: {"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt, "reach"?: pt} (a click on a table's insert button: left of a row border adds a row there, above a column border a column; the new row or column is selected, as in Word)

label: Move Table by Dragging
params: {"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt, "toX": pt, "toY": pt, "reach"?: pt} (a drag from the move handle past a table's top-left corner: the table floats where it's dropped, the text wrapping around it; tables in the main text only)

label: AutoFit Column by Double-Clicking
params: {"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt, "reach"?: pt} (a double-click on a column border: the column left of it fits its contents and the columns right of it keep their widths, moving with the border, so the table narrows or widens (up to the right margin), as in Word)
